items.title: Is Braskem Worth Buying as Low Valuation Meets Heavy Financial Risk?
items.summary: Braskem's deeply discounted valuation and improving plant utilization offer recovery potential, but cash burn, debt restructuring and shareholder dilution pose significant risks.

items.title: Can Braskem's Proposed Recapitalization Repair Its Strained Finances?
items.summary: Braskem's proposed $3.6 billion debt reduction and $2.25 billion equity raise could ease financial strain, but dilution and execution risks remain.

items.title: BAK Falls 34.7% in 1 Week: Can Its Operating Recovery Offset Risks?
items.summary: Braskem shares plunge 34.7% in a week as rising debt and restructuring risks challenge its operating recovery, despite stronger Brazilian resin sales.

items.title: 15 of the Highest-Yielding Dividend Stocks in the S&P 500
items.summary: VICI Properties, UPS and General Mills lead the list of the highest-yielding dividend stocks in the S&P 500. Some of the other names might surprise you.

items.title: $400,000 in These 4 Dividend Stocks Could Pay $21,000 a Year, but 2 Already Cut Payouts
items.summary: A $400,000 chemical-sector income plan looks tempting until you notice that half of it already slashed payouts once. Which two names cut, and could the steadiest check in the group still hold up for a retiree?

items.title: 4 Chemical and Materials Stocks Yielding Over 4% for Retirees Who Want Income
items.summary: Retirees crowd into utilities and REITs while four chemical and packaging payers quietly offer fatter checks. Two have already slashed their dividends, and the real test is which payouts the cash flow can actually defend.

items.title: 3 Overlooked Dividend Stocks Paying 5% or More Right Now
items.summary: Big yields tempt income investors, but one famous chemical payer just slashed its dividend nearly in half. Three overlooked names clear the 5% bar, and the real test is whether their cash flow actually covers the checks.

items.title: LyondellBasell Stock Outlook: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish?
items.summary: LyondellBasell has outperformed the broader market over the past year, and analysts are moderately optimistic about the stock’s prospects.
